recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No FHIR core source follow-up is recommended for FHIR-7729 unless a future module redesign reintroduces confusing clinical-versus-medications grouping labels.
issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core technical correction asking to fix a 2015May clinical page grouping mislabeled as "Medications & Immunizations" with medication/immunization support text.
initial_application: Git-svn import commit 1f4415a054ddf304b1cf64361337c010a9dab2c5, subject "#7729 - typo", changed source/clinical.html from "Medications & Immunizations|Support the medication & Immunization process" to "Data Collection/Care Plan|Support the collecting data, and managing the care process". The commit's SVN build id matches the Jira comment "fixed #5336".
additional_context: The old source/clinical.html page has since been removed/refactored. The current active equivalent is source/clinicalsummary-module.html, referenced by source/hierarchy.xml as the Clinical page and by module lists/fragments as clinicalsummary-module.html. Current source titles the area "Clinical"/"Clinical Module", lists core clinical and care-process resources, and points medication ordering/administration to the separate Medications Module. Same-page neighbors FHIR-8124 and FHIR-8282 confirm this was a category/header family, but they do not require a separate source edit for the seed.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit on the combined branch. No source hunk is needed because the current build-scope source no longer contains the misleading grouping label or support text.

related_jiras.note: Published issue on the same 2015May clinical page category headings, recorded as done for another task; used as context but not separately decided.
Resolved No Change issue reporting the same wrong second header, with a comment that it was already fixed; supports the no-change conclusion for the seed.
